def transform2(grid):
    n=len(grid)
    out=[]
    for r in range(3*n):
        rr=r%n if (r//n)%2==0 else n-1-r%n
        row=[]
        for c in range(3*n):
            cc=c%n if (c//n)%2==0 else n-1-c%n
            row.append(grid[n-1-rr][n-1-cc])
        out.append(row)
    return out
